node.html: Corrective RAG is an LLM-powered document assistant built with LlamaIndex's agentic workflow, using FastEmbed for semantic search, Qdrant for vector storage, and a web fallback mechanism triggered by score-based relevance evaluation.

frontmatter.title: Globe-Wire AI (Hybrid Agentic RAG-based News App)

node.html: Globe-Wire AI is an agentic AI-powered system that fetches, analyzes, and answers questions about real-time global news using state-of-the-art open-source tools. It combines live data fetching, semantic understanding, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to deliver meaningful insights from current events.

Developed a Generative AI chatbot using LangChain, LangSmith, and Streamlit, with an LCEL-powered RAG pipeline that ingests documentation, generates OpenAI embeddings, stores them in Pinecone, and enables real-time contextual Q&A with session traceability

Built a deep learning-based sentiment classifier for tweets using Bidirectional LSTM with Attention and pre-trained GloVe embeddings. Applied advanced NLP and regularization techniques to ensure strong generalization and minimal overfitting.
